# Supported practice at the admissions desk

The first supported practice shift included a printer failure, a lost booking and a visitor who wanted to sit down before paying. We learned more from the interruptions than the prepared exercises. The new volunteer asked to repeat the opening with Rafi next week. [[Volunteer handbook]] should preserve that request as useful feedback rather than mark the training incomplete.
